main_body: wooden church pew (backrest, horizontal seat plank, front apron/supports)
top_band: light tan/orange horizontal seat surface at rows 7-10 (below the vertical backrest at rows 0-6)
evidence: Reading down a center column: rows 0-6 form the upright backrest (dark top rail at 0, lighter edge at 1, vertical face at 2-6). Rows 7-10 form a distinct 4-row lighter horizontal seat surface seen from above, with a bright front edge line at row 10, a dark eave shadow directly beneath at row 11, and a recessed front apron at rows 12-13 flanked by side supports extending to row 14.

style.evidence: The wood material uses a 6-step warm brown ramp with dark brown material outlines on the interior and outer edges (some black shadow under the base and between outer trim). The seat plank includes subtle wood grain variations across rows 8-9, avoiding large flat fills, though the straight horizontal bands are slightly simpler than the reference stalls.
